units.source_text: 我已经不知说过多少次了。

en.t: I no longer know how many times I have said it.

units.source_text: 知果鹤川忠于他的职责，

en.t: If Tsurukawa had been faithful to his duty,

units.source_text: 他就不应该对我刨根问底，

en.t: he should not have pressed me with questions,

units.source_text: 而应该不闻不问，如实地把我灰暗的感情翻译成明亮的感情。

en.t: but should have asked nothing and said nothing, faithfully translating my dark feelings into bright ones.

units.source_text: 那时候，虚假将会变成真实，而真实的就将会变成虚假。

en.t: Then falsehood would have become truth, and what was true would have become false.

units.source_text: 如果鹤川能发挥他那种天生的做法：

en.t: If Tsurukawa could have brought out that inborn way of his:

units.source_text: 把所有的背阴译成向阳，
把所有的黑夜译成白昼，

en.t: translating every dark night into broad daylight,

units.source_text: 把所有的月光译成日光，
把所有的夜间质朴的阴湿译成白昼晶亮的嫩叶在摇曳，

en.t: translating all the plain damp gloom of night into gleaming young leaves swaying in daylight,

units.source_text: 那么，我或许会结结巴巴地忏悔所有这一切。

en.t: then perhaps I would have stammered out a confession of all of this.

units.source_text: 然而在这节骨眼上，他偏偏没有这样做。

en.t: Yet at this crucial moment, he perversely failed to do so.

units.source_text: 于是，我的灰暗的感情就获得了力量……

en.t: And so my dark feelings gained strength...
